title: Undead building looks: the Graveyard (Farm) and the Bone Mill (Windmill)

recipes.negativeAddendum: skull, skeleton, bones, zombie, coffin, open grave, white headstone, pale headstone, round-topped tombstone, ghost, fog, candles, pumpkin, green plants, vegetables, cabbages, tree stumps, logs, pink, grass
recipes.notes: Pixflux drew pink slabs on grass (flux-a) and stumps and pumpkins (flux-b). Pixen, with a subject of dark pointed slate gravestones instead of crosses on mounds.

recipes.promptAddendum: The whole graveyard is drawn large, about three quarters of the image wide, and touches no edge of the image.
recipes.notes: Bead pulp_wars-2o7.2, first sample of the Graveyard as its own thing (the user: the rows of identical tombstones imitate the farm and are not readable): a fenced plot, three different stones, a bare tree.

recipes.promptAddendum: At the back of the plot stands one small stone crypt with a peaked charcoal roof and a small arched door glowing soft violet. The whole graveyard is drawn large, about three quarters of the image wide, and touches no edge of the image.
recipes.notes: Second sample: the plot with a little crypt at the back.

recipes.promptAddendum: A small lantern with a soft violet flame hangs on a short post beside the gap in the fence. The whole graveyard is drawn large, about three quarters of the image wide, and touches no edge of the image.
recipes.notes: Third sample: the plot with a violet lantern at the gate.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only two things. Make the gravestones a lighter slate blue-grey (#8b92a3) with a mid slate shade (#6a7082), clearly lighter than the fence and the earth. Make the plot of earth a flat thin patch with no thick dark side walls under it. Keep the dark iron fence, the bare tree, the violet lantern flame, the size, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: graveyard-plot-c reads as a fenced graveyard at a glance and is the cleanest of the three, but its stones are nearly as dark as its fence and it stands on a slab with side walls.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only two things. Make the orange-brown earth a dark dusty grey-brown (#5d5552), a flat thin patch with no thick side walls under it. Make the gravestones and the crypt walls a lighter slate blue-grey (#8b92a3) with a mid slate shade (#6a7082). Keep the crypt, its near-black roof and violet door, the bare tree, the cross, the fence, the size, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: graveyard-plot-b has the most character (a crypt with a violet door, a cross, a tree), but its earth is orange and it stands on a thick isometric block.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the colours and the sail cloth of this windmill: the tower becomes dark slate-grey stone (#5a5f6b), the cone roof near-black charcoal (#2b2b31), the four sails become ragged torn charcoal-grey cloth with holes and tattered edges on dark wooden arms, and the small window glows violet (#a221ee). Nothing is red, cream or terracotta any more. Keep the windmill's shape, size, the X of four sails, the door, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: The Undead Windmill as an edit of the accepted shared Windmill, so the canvas, footprint and silhouette stay.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only one thing: the red roofs. The cone roof on top and the small roof over the door become near-black charcoal slate (#2b2b31) with a dark grey edge (#44454d), with no red, no orange and no brown left on them. Do not redraw anything else: the dark stone tower, the four dark ragged sails, the violet windows, the door, the outline and the art style stay exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: bone-mill-edit-a has the dark tower, the ragged sails and the violet windows, but kept its terracotta-red roofs.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only one thing: the stone of the round tower. The tower walls become a lighter slate blue-grey stone (#8b92a3) with a mid-grey shade (#6a7082) and a few darker stone joints, clearly lighter than the roofs and the sails. Do not redraw anything else: the near-black charcoal roofs, the four dark ragged sails on their wooden arms, the violet windows, the door, the outline and the art style stay exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: Bead pulp_wars-xdh.2: bone-mill-edit-b is a black windmill shape at zoom 0.75 (tower, roofs and sails are one tone). A lighter slate tower separates the three.
